title: Yellow Braised Chinese Pork Stew
description:
A hearty, comforting stew made with pork belly, scallions, and fermented soybean paste, served in a portable bento box.
This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly dish is the perfect remedy for a sick day.

ingredients.name: pork belly
ingredients.notes: score the fat in a diamond pattern for even browning

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork belly on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, then saut7 the ginger and garlic until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the fermented soybean paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the cider vinegar, soy sauce, and 1 cup of water to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the pork belly to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Add the star anise and Chinese five-spice powder to the pot and continue to simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped scallions and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the stew in individual bento boxes, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
